integration.about: The LAA build (project-laa.yml): every unit class and every UI class, in a private lab lane (real Bridge, isolated Work engine, synthetic fixtures).

exclude_classes.LAALabCaptureUITests: Capture tool, not a behavior test: it runs only from scripts/laa/lab/capture.py, which supplies its own fixtures and environment. Its pass/fail is capture.py's exit code.
exclude_classes.LAAAmbientCaptureUITests: Capture tool, not a behavior test: it photographs the staff Live Activities from the app's DEBUG fixture for the ambient (HO-15) evidence. Its shots, not a pass, are its output.
exclude_classes.LAAPerformanceUITests: Measurement tool, not a behavior test: it runs only from scripts/laa/lab/perf.py, which supplies its own fixture, quiet-machine rule and baseline comparison.
exclude_classes.ConnectionRepairUITests: Upstream-only entry point: the LAA build replaces this screen with its own shell, so the class cannot reach it. It runs where it applies, in the default build (upstream suite).
exclude_classes.ConnectionSetupSettingsUITests: Upstream-only entry point: the LAA build replaces this screen with its own shell, so the class cannot reach it. It runs where it applies, in the default build (upstream suite).
exclude_classes.ProfilePickerUITests: Upstream-only entry point: the LAA build replaces this screen with its own shell, so the class cannot reach it. It runs where it applies, in the default build (smoke and upstream suite).

smoke.about: The default Conduit build (project.yml): the merge gate's selection from scripts/smoke-suite.json.

upstream.about: The default Conduit build (project.yml): every unit class and the upstream-only UI classes. It proves that a test listed as not-applicable in the LAA build (upstream copy the LAA brand layer replaces, upstream screens the LAA shell replaces) still passes where it applies.
